content: Scaffold with npm create vite@latest <name> -- --template react (or react-ts); Vite requires Node ^20.19 or >=22.12. Registry-verified current: vite 8.1.4, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.0.3 (peer requires vite ^8.0.0), react 19.2.7. Standard structure: src/ with main.jsx/App.jsx, vite.config.js at root.
